patch_description: The current program optimizes the hard min-area objective from a single handcrafted seed, which gets stuck: the min-area landscape is highly degenerate (many flat plateaus), and single-coordinate random moves rarely escape poor basins. Two expert-motivated changes: (1) a soft-min (log-sum-exp over the smallest 15-25% of the 165 triangle areas) coarse phase, which gives a smooth gradient-like signal to escape plateaus and lift many small triangles simultaneously, followed by the hard min objective for fine polishing; (2) deterministic multi-start over several structured seeds (perturbed lattices, edge-heavy layouts) with the best result kept, giving better basin coverage. Areas are cached per-iteration in vectorized form (only 165 triplets, cheap). Final greedy coordinate-pattern polish squeezes out remaining slack. Determinism preserved via fixed seeds and fixed iteration counts.
